title: The Sixteenth Semester
author: Coral Underhill
blurb: Kestrel Nakamura, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
